reason: No published email and no contact form: her website laiaboveyoga.com now returns a Wix 'connect your domain' 404, and her Substack, Insight Timer and Yoga Alliance pages publish no address or form (Medium was not opened because its robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot); her work is also framed mainly as nervous-system care for chronic illness and burnout, which would leave little after the health-claim rule.
